name: One Slime Army
author: Isaiah Billingsley
description: An endless wave survival arcade game: a humble slime with sword and shield battles hordes of enemies. Arrows to move, hold Z to block, release to attack, X to dash.

descriptions.en: An endless wave survival arcade game: a humble slime with sword and shield battles hordes of enemies. Arrows to move, hold Z to block, release to attack, X to dash.
descriptions.it: Arcade di sopravvivenza a ondate infinite: uno slime con spada e scudo affronta orde di nemici. Frecce per muoverti, tieni Z per parare e rilascia per attaccare, X scatto.
